Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents CRAFTY-Sweden, an agent-based land-use model explicitly implemented at the national scale of Sweden (1 km² resolution) to simulate future land-use change in the forestry and agricultural sectors from 2010 to 2100. Its primary objective is to project land-use dynamics under multiple socio-economic and climate scenarios (five SSP-RCP combinations), directly addressing LULC prediction as a core research question. The study includes quantitative comparisons across scenarios (e.g., percentage changes in land use by type and region, mapped spatial outputs in Figures 4–5), and produces explicit mapped projections of land-use and land-owner distributions. It meets all core inclusion criteria: national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC simulation, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatially explicit modeling, and mapped LULC outputs. It does not trigger any exclusion criteria—focus is not ecological/species-specific, it is not methodological without application, and it goes beyond single-scenario or qualitative analysis.)
